adminSteps: Open the page; root is the last div.card (the Signing secret card). Show secret and Copy secret are 28px icon-only buttons (aria-labels); Create new secret is a text button inside the card, not a section action. Modal: click Create new secret via element.click() on the shadow button; cancel after measuring. The hidden tab left the dialog mid-animation (opacity 0), so its width and height are not recorded.

modal.adminSteps: Click Create new secret. Dialog radius 24, white, with shadow. Title 15/22 500; first paragraph 13/20 400 #101010 (future subscriptions use the new secret); second paragraph 13/20 400 #4a4a4a (waiting notifications may use the previous secret); checkbox; Cancel (text pill, 61 wide) and Create new secret (122 wide) in the footer, the latter disabled (bg #000000/13, white text) until the box is ticked. Close x button 27px at top right.
